I’d expect the AXI-Lite SBA master to touch both the Debug side (SBA/DCM), the bus interconnect that needs a new master port, and the top-level wrapper to actually expose/wire that port out. In particular, you’ll likely need to:

1. Extend the SBA implementation itself to work over AXI-Lite instead of APB or wishbone.  
2. Hook that new AXI-Lite SBA master into the global AXI-Lite interconnect.  
3. Wire the new signals through the top-level SoC wrapper.  
4. Make sure the Debug Module (DM) or System Bus Access controller instantiates/uses the new AXI-Lite SBA.

From the skeleton list, the four files I’d update (most to least critical) are:

```  
hw/ip/snitch/rtl/debug/sba.sv  
hw/ip/snitch/rtl/debug/dm.sv  
hw/ip/snitch/rtl/bus/axi_lite_interconnect.sv  
hw/ip/snitch/rtl/top.sv  
```
